seed: Objects of type `marker` under action ACTION6 with touching neighbours [hit,wall] show mixed outcomes: gone x1, no_change x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Blocks move in mirrored four-cell steps; armed players stay fixed.
Inactive clicked markers activate; active clicked markers are unchanged.
Maze, marker and player occupancy guard movement; objects get scan-order names.
Timer phase is retained only when the full incoming state equals the last prediction.
Unseen maze cells and ACTION7 are unconfirmed; fallback uses the earliest compatible timer age.
